detail.longDescription:
Device Monitor² is a one-of-a-kind app designed for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, providing all the essential information about your device at a glance, quickly and effortlessly. Discover which sensors apps have access to and take control of your privacy.  

Why choose Device Monitor²?  
Here are some of its main features:  
• Clear and intuitive data visualization;
• Detailed information about:  
   - DEVICE,  
   - SENSORS,  
   - RAM,  
   - STORAGE,  
   - CPU,  
   - GPU,  
   - NETWORK,  
   - BATTERY,  
   - DISPLAY,  
   - CAMERA.  
• Shortcuts to the Shortcuts app;
• Shortcuts to the Control Center (requires iOS 18);
• Customizable widgets for StandBy Mode, Lock Screen and the Home Screen;
• Options to hide or reorder panels according to your needs;
• App icon customization.  

Unlock advanced features with additional packs:  
• PRO Kit:  
   - Access to all features of other in-app purchases (present and future);
   - Deep memory cleaning;
   - Support for opening .synced files;
   - Copy and paste data displayed in the app.
• PiP Kit:
   - Access to Picture-in-Picture mode (both “compact” and “extended” modes) for real-time monitoring of:
       → RAM,
       → CPU,
       → NETWORK.
• Test Kit:  
   - Complete testing of device sensors, including:  
       → GPS,  
       → Compass,  
       → Altimeter,  
       → Accelerometer,  
       → Shake,
       → Magnetometer,  
       → Gyroscope,  
       → Barometer,  
       → Device Motion,  
       → Motion Coprocessor,  
       → Pedometer,  
       → Bluetooth,  
       → iBeacon,  
       → Microphone,  
       → Volume,  
       → Speakers,  
       → Proximity Sensor,  
       → NFC,  
       → Touch ID,  
       → Vibration and Haptic Feedback,  
       → Ping,  
       → Traceroute,  
       → DNS Lookup,  
       → Acid3,  
       → Speed Test,  
       → Network Device Scanner,  
       → Brightness,  
       → Multi-touch,  
       → Screen Color,  
       → Camera,  
       → Flash.  
• Report Kit:  
   - Export data displayed in the app as a PDF, CSV, XLSX or RFT document.  
• Notification Kit:  
   - Customizable notifications for:  
       → RAM usage exceeding limits,
       → Device temperature reaching abnormal levels.  
• Ads Kit:  
   - Remove ads from the app.  


The app does not collect any personal data or even non-personal data. Why? Simple: We’re not interested!
Oh, and don’t forget: the app is FREE!
